task.title: M5: Hide files from the analysis via right-click, per repo
task.description:
Some files (CHANGELOG.md, generated assets, lockfiles that slipped through) distort a comparison. Add a way to hide files at least temporarily: right-click a file block in any treemap or a file node in the graph and choose Hide <path> (a small custom context menu, not the browser's). Hidden paths are stored per repo in localStorage keyed by repoId, applied in the web app before rendering every view (file removed from files, functions, modules file lists, and edges in both the snapshot and the diff; totals and summary counts recomputed), and shown as a chip in the summary bar such as 3 hidden with a popover listing the paths, each with an unhide button, and a Clear all. Hiding is a view-level filter only: cached snapshots and the server are untouched.

Acceptance criteria:
- Right-clicking CHANGELOG.md in the compare treemap and choosing Hide removes it from the treemap, the edges graph, and the summary totals immediately, and the chip reads 1 hidden.
- The hidden set persists across reloads and across the Treemap, Graph, and Compare views for the same repo, and does not leak to another repo.
- Unhide restores the file; Clear all empties the set.
- Hidden files never appear as graph nodes or ghost nodes, and edges touching them are dropped.
- Headless Chrome check covers hide, persist across reload, and unhide with no console errors.
